text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - An exporter Friday sold Brazilian buyers 17,000 tonnes of wheat at $185 a tonne, not including freight, traders said. The wheat was sold for May shipment from the port of Necochea, they said.

- The Commodity Credit Corp of USDA said it bought 7,220 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat from Archer Daniels Midland Co for donation to Bosnia. The price was $193.01 per tonne, FOB, and was for May 7-31 shipment.

COPRA SALE - South Korean feed millers on Tuesday bought 6,400 tonnes of copra at $116.50 a tonne C&F, from Nidera, South Korean traders said. Arrival for 3,400 tonnes was for July 25 and the balance by August 15 to the southeastern port of Ulsan.
WHEAT TENDERS - Taiwan will retender on April 23 for two shipments of U.S. wheat totalling 68,000 tonnes. Taiwan had passed on the tender on Tuesday due to high prices.
- Results were awaited on Iraq's tender from April 18 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for June arrival.
WHEAT TENDERS - Results are awaited on Algeria's tender for 100,000 tonnes of optional durum wheat for shipment in May and June.

- Taiwan Flour Millers Association seeks Wednesday 68,300 tonnes of U.S. wheat, U.S. exporters said. It seeks 34,000 tonnes for April 25-May 15 shipment (17,300 tonnes spring wheat, 11,600 tonnes hard red winter wheat and 5,100 tonnes white wheat) and 34,300 tonnes for May 15-June 5 shipment (18,300 tonnes spring wheat, 11,500 tonnes hard red winter and 4,500 tonnes white wheat).
WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan was to tender May 1 for 120,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter and/or northern spring wheat for May/June shipment.
SORGHUM TENDER - The CCC will tender April 22 for up to 5,000 tonnes sorghum for export to Kenya, May 5-31 shipment.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey on April 29 seeks 150,000 tonnes of barley in three 50,000-tonne shipments. It seeks white feed and malting white barley for May 15-22, June 1-15 and June 1-15 shipment.
RICE TENDER - South Korea is to tender at the end of June to buy 77,000 tonnes of rice to meet its 1997 WTO quota.

OILSEED TENDER - Results were awaited on South Korea's tender for 53,500 tonnes of oilseeds meal, including 14,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal, 6,500 tonnes cottonseed meal, 8,000 tonnes of grain screening pellet and 25,000 tonnes of palm kernel meal.
SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador is to tender April 28 for 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of PL-480 soybean meal for May 7-22 shipment, the buyer's agent said.

COMMODITY TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp of USDA said it will tender April 29 for pinto beans, sunflower oil, bulgur and wheat-soy blend for donation to Moldova. It seeks 255 tonnes of pinto beans, 605 tonnes of sunflower oil, 510 tonnes of bulgur (cracked wheat), and 255 tonnes of a wheat-soy blend. The beans, bulgur and wheat-soy blend were for June 6-20 shipment and the oil was for June 20-July 5.

MARKET TALK - Brazilian millers are experiencing problems obtaining quality wheat and are hoping discussions with U.S. government officials will resolve current problems over phytosanitary requirements, millers said. Brazilian and U.S. officials have been negotiating over stricter Brazilian entry requirements for wheat which in theory took effect as of January 1 last year but which only came into practice after a waiver expired at the end of September.
